questions.question: SSH nima va qanday ishlaydi (qisqacha)?
questions.explanation: Secure Shell — shifrlangan masofaviy kirish protokoli (TCP 22). Bosqichlar: TCP ulanish -> versiya almashinuvi -> key exchange (DH/ECDH) -> server host key'ni tekshirish -> user autentifikatsiya (parol/kalit) -> shifrlangan sessiya/kanallar.

questions.question: SSH kalit bilan kirishni noldan qanday sozlaysan?
questions.explanation: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` -> `ssh-copy-id user@host` (yoki public key'ni `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` ga qo'sh) -> ruxsatlar 700/600 -> `ssh user@host` -> keyin parolni o'chir.

questions.question: sshd_config'ni production uchun qanday sozlaysan (hardening)?
questions.explanation: Parol login o'chiq, root login o'chiq, faqat kalit, AllowUsers/AllowGroups, MaxAuthTries, LoginGraceTime, X11/agent forwarding o'chiq, zamonaviy algoritmlar; `sshd -t` bilan tekshirib reload; fail2ban/firewall.

questions.question: `~/.ssh/config` nima uchun? Misol.
questions.explanation: Client sozlamalari: alias, HostName, User, Port, IdentityFile, ProxyJump. Uzun `ssh -i ... -p ... user@ip` o'rniga `ssh prod`.

questions.question: SSH tunnel: `-L`, `-R`, `-D` farqi?
questions.explanation: -L local forward: lokal port -> server orqali uzoq manzil. -R remote forward: server porti -> sizning lokal manzil. -D dynamic: SOCKS proxy.

questions.question: Bastion (jump host) orqali kirish: `ProxyJump` va agent forwarding farqi, xavfi?
questions.explanation: `ssh -J bastion target` — kalit lokal qoladi, bastion faqat TCP'ni uzatadi (xavfsiz). Agent forwarding (`-A`) — bastion'dagi root sizning agent'ingizdan foydalana oladi (xavfli).

questions.question: `Permission denied (publickey)` — qanday debug qilasan?
questions.explanation: `ssh -vvv` client tomonida qaysi kalit taklif qilinganini ko'r; server tomonda `journalctl -u ssh` / `/var/log/auth.log`; ruxsatlar (home, .ssh 700, authorized_keys 600, egasi), to'g'ri user, AllowUsers, SELinux konteksti.

questions.question: `WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED!` — nima qilasan?
questions.explanation: Server host key known_hosts'dagidan farq qiladi: server qayta o'rnatilgan/IP qayta ishlatilgan YOKI MITM hujum. Avval sababni tasdiqla, keyin `ssh-keygen -R host`.

questions.question: scp, rsync va sftp farqi? Kerakli flaglar.
questions.explanation: scp — oddiy nusxa. rsync — faqat farqni yuboradi, davom ettiradi, ruxsatlarni saqlaydi (katta/takroriy ko'chirish uchun). sftp — interaktiv fayl sessiyasi.

questions.question: Yuzlab server va ko'p muhandis uchun SSH access'ni qanday boshqarasan?
questions.explanation: authorized_keys'ni qo'lda tarqatish shkalalanmaydi. Variantlar: SSH CA (qisqa muddatli user sertifikatlari), SSO bilan Teleport/Boundary, AWS SSM/GCP IAP (portsiz), config management. Audit, offboarding, MFA, break-glass.

questions.question: SSH ulanish sekin (login 10-30s). Sabablari?
questions.explanation: Ko'pincha DNS reverse lookup (`UseDNS yes`), GSSAPI auth urinishi, ko'p kalit sinash, sekin PAM/LDAP, MOTD skriptlar, entropiya. `ssh -vvv` da qaysi qadamda to'xtashini ko'r.

questions.question: fail2ban nima va SSH brute-force'dan qanday himoyalanasan?
questions.explanation: fail2ban loglarni kuzatadi va N ta muvaffaqiyatsiz urinishdan keyin IP'ni firewall bilan vaqtincha bloklaydi. Asosiy himoya baribir: parolni o'chirish, faqat kalit, 22 portni cheklash.

questions.question: SSH orqali ishlayotgan Ansible/CI deploy vaqti-vaqti bilan `Connection reset` / `Broken pipe` bilan yiqiladi. Sabablar?
questions.explanation: Idle timeout (NAT gateway, LB, firewall ~350s), sshd `MaxStartups` (bir vaqtda ko'p auth'siz ulanish — 10:30:100 default), `MaxSessions` (ControlMaster bilan), server yuklamasi, ClientAlive sozlamalari. Yechim: keepalive, MaxStartups oshirish, ControlPersist, forks'ni moslash.

questions.question: SSH host key, user key va sertifikat rotatsiyasini qanday rejalashtirasan? Xodim ketganda nima qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Offboarding: IdP'da hisobni o'chirish -> SSH sertifikatlar avtomatik tugaydi (qisqa TTL) yoki authorized_keys'dan kalitni hamma serverdan olib tashlash (config management), umumiy secret'lar rotatsiyasi, audit. Host key rotatsiyasi: `UpdateHostKeys`, host sertifikat.
